changelog_hero_body.message: Open any YouTube video and you’ll see the dislike count right next to the likes, where it belongs. Version 4.1 also introduces RYD comments, a place to talk about videos outside YouTube’s own comment section.

changelog_comments_body.message: A community discussion under videos and Shorts, hosted by Return YouTube Dislike and kept separate from YouTube’s comments. Everyone can read and react. Commenter and Premium members can post and reply.

changelog_comments_point_replies.message: Threaded replies with likes and dislikes

changelog_comments_point_nickname.message: Post under a public nickname you choose

changelog_comments_point_notifications.message: Notifications when someone replies or reacts

changelog_comments_point_moderation.message: Reporting and moderation to keep things civil

changelog_comments_shot_alt.message: RYD comments panel showing a threaded discussion under a video

changelog_notifications_shot_alt.message: RYD notifications listing replies and likes on your comments

changelog_analytics_body.message: See how a video is received over time and around the world. Pick 7, 30 or 90 days or all time, and compare likes, dislikes and ratio.

changelog_analytics_timeline_body.message: Likes and dislikes over time, down to the hour.

changelog_analytics_countries_body.message: See which countries like and dislike a video the most.

changelog_analytics_us_body.message: Zoom in on engagement by state.

changelog_join_free.message: Dislike counts are free for everyone. Membership is optional and helps support the project.

changelog_join_step1.message: Join on Patreon. Commenter lets you post comments; Premium adds analytics too.

changelog_join_step3.message: Reload any YouTube video. Your new features appear automatically.

changelog_also_counts.message: Like and dislike counts display more reliably, in the extension and the userscript.

changelog_also_consent.message: Improved data consent flow in Firefox.

reviewPromptBody.message:
Google changed the rules for Chrome Web Store ratings. Despite 16,000+ five-star reviews, a few recent negative ones dragged RYD’s rating from 4.6 to 2.5.

If RYD helps you, please leave an honest review.
